id: title:Gilbert09:find microsoft sql server when searching for azure sql

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL keywords to the MSSQL source configuration, potentially improving discoverability of the MSSQL connector for warehouse users searching for Azure SQL Database.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 adds search keywords to the MSSQL source configuration. This is a narrow, localized maintenance change. While it could help users find the connector, the actual connector implementation and backend queries are absent, and the tier is not a systemic capability or critical path improvement. No score 3 or 2 is supported.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the Azure SQL Database connector; P1.F2.H1 only tests searchability, not actual functionality. The benefit is conjectural and not demonstrated by the code.
